prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, improvement of an existing game location. Image 1 is an in-game screenshot of a community skate park in a forest clearing in the game Yorimichi: pale concrete bowls, quarter pipes and full pipes, several pieces raised high in the air on only one or two thin steel poles, which looks flimsy and strange, and a steel and timber stair tower behind. Image 2 is the Mega Park in the same game and shows the art direction to match: soft painterly low-poly shapes, flat matte shading, warm weathered concrete, faded indigo paint, honey-coloured wood, wooden lantern posts, indigo cloth banners with a white wave crest, autumn maples and ginkgos in rust, orange and gold, dark green pines, a clean blue sky. Repaint image 1 as the AFTER concept from exactly the same camera, with the boy standing in the same place. Every skating piece keeps exactly its shape, height and place, and the riding surfaces and the air directly above them stay clear of any structure or object. The supports change: every raised ramp now stands on a sturdy, believable structure placed beside and beneath its outside edges, never in a bowl or on a riding line: four-legged steel trestle towers with horizontal struts and X cross-bracing on every storey, painted faded indigo, standing on small concrete footings, with diagonal knee braces rising to deep girders under each ramp deck, so the weight visibly goes down to the ground. No piece is held by a single pole. The stair tower stays as it is. Keep the painterly low-poly game look. No UI, no labels, no letters, no logos, no text of any kind.

Use case: stylized-concept, restyle of an existing game location. Repaint image 1 as the AFTER concept from exactly the same camera. Every skating piece keeps exactly its shape, height and place, and the riding surfaces and the air directly above them stay clear of any structure or object. Only materials and decoration change, so the park feels characterful and loved: the white concrete becomes warm light-grey concrete with soft painterly trowel marks, gentle colour variation and faint expansion joints; every coping becomes a painted steel pipe in faded indigo; the vertical outer walls and sides of the raised pieces get bold painted panels: deep indigo with white seigaiha wave crests, vermilion with a large stylised sunburst, mustard yellow with simple scattered maple leaves; one bowl floor carries a large faded painted circle motif; the steel frames and rails are faded indigo. Around the outer deck edges, away from every riding line, add low wooden benches, stone planters with small maples, two wooden lantern posts and an indigo cloth banner. Keep the painterly low-poly game look. No UI, no labels, no letters, no logos, no text of any kind.
